messages:
deploybot: tag created `release-2026-03-20-v3.8.0` for prod cut
env: prod
commit: `a1b2c3d4` (build 452)
changelog (summary):
- reduce KV cache lock contention under high throughput
- runtime: add auto-batcher to improve tail latency for short sequences
- infra: fix region failover for private deployments
canary plan: 10% -> 30 min -> 30% -> 2h -> 100%
canary window start: 2026-03-20T18:00Z
pin guidance: set `prod_model: v3.8.0` in infra config if you need an immutable model pin
rollback thresholds: >5% error rate OR 3x median latency baseline across 5m window triggers auto-rollback
notes: --allow-hotfixing disabled for this cut. if a hotfix is needed we do a follow-up rc.
release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-20-v3.8.0 || short tag: https://git.redwood/commit/a1b2c3d4
@here starting the canary at the scheduled time, monitoring dashboards linked below

ashwin: ack, will watch latency and errors, I can jump on pager if we hit thresholds :thumbsup:

lucy: quick question — are we changing default batching config? will that require client-side retries?

mike: lucy — no client changes expected. batching is server-only and opt-in per-route. we log when route gets auto-batched.

ops-bot: canary-checker: scheduled checks -> latency_p95, error_rate, 5xx_count, model_quality_drift. alerts wired to #eng-oncall and paging policy.

ashwin: putting a manual watch window 18:00-20:30 UTC, will escalate at first sign of perf regression.

lucy: also pin request from partner-team for eu-prod. @deploybot can you add note to deployment ticket to not auto-roll their routes?

deploybot: noted — added `partner-team: no-auto-rollback` tag on the release ticket and annotated env matrix.

mike: small snippet for anyone reviewing logs:```
[2026-03-20T18:05:12Z] INFO canary: routed 1200 reqs, p95=120ms, errors=0.4%
```

deploybot: canary started successfully. will post interim metrics at +15m and +60m. if no issues, next ramp at +30m.

ashwin: thanks — will monitor dashboards and run a quick smoke to verify end-to-end for embeddings path.

lucy: approving pin for eu-prod after smoke passes.

mike: FYI ops, if rollback is triggered, rollback tag is `rollback-2026-03-20-v3.7.9` and will be auto-applied to routes with `auto-rollback: enabled`. manual pin remains possible.

ops-bot: reminder: remind the docs team to publish the short changelog snippet to the status page if we hit full rollout.

ashwin: noted. posting summary in #customer-status once 100% is reached or if rollback occurs.

deploybot: final: tag created + canary in progress. contact @ashwin/@mike for immediate follow-ups.
